rationale: SOFI is trading at 98.1% of its intraday range after a 10.5% gap-up on strong earnings news, with price essentially at the session high ($16.73 vs high $16.75). Entering long at this extreme extension risks buying the top of a news-driven spike with minimal upside to the high and significant mean-reversion risk; entering short against strong fundamental momentum and a stock pressing highs with 6x relative volume is equally dangerous. The risk/reward in either direction is unfavorable at this moment.
